comments.author: trap
comments.body_html:
Hey look like a very promising little mod here.

A little suggestion about the packaging of your mod, you should provide it in a zip for 2 reasons:

1. It give the opportunity for people to disable their antivirus (with some softwares it destroy the file on download and you can do nothing)

2. You can respect the structure of directories BepInEx/plugins/YourMod.dll for easier the installation

Anyway, I always appreciate when the source code of a mod is provided, it’s always good for learning purpose (especially with little mod like this one) Thank you for that.
